fields.name: Length of additional information requested contents
fields.description: Length of additional information requested contents

fields.name: Spare
fields.description: Spare bits (bits 8 to 2 of octet 3 are spare and shall be coded as zero)

fields.name: Cipher Key
fields.description: Ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data (CipherKey) (octet 3, bit 1): 0 = ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data not requested, 1 = ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested

notes: The Additional information requested is a type 4 information element with a length of 3 octets.
Bits 8 to 2 of octet 3 are spare and shall be coded as zero.
